counterexamples.evidence: WorkspaceCommandAuthorizationService already maps the server-supplied target type to the target-specific capability; the failure is the upstream target model, not a reason to remove the owner recheck.
OrganizationTaskPathService isScopeAllowed rejects peer branches and preserves leaf exact identity; no repair may widen it.
WorkspaceOperationsInvitationCreateRequest retains its original final hash, demonstrating the SHA comparison is not an all-output false positive.
P0 is a control-only package and is a valid NOT_APPLICABLE business counterexample; obligation must be explicit rather than inferred from source paths.

findings.finding: The five frozen target tasks collapse into eight generic operation identities; assignment.serviceNodeType becomes target type, causing wrong population or descendant 404.
Current 015/016 receipt edges exist but the replay artifact has no terminal current-chain model and no mechanical replay-terminal-to-exit equality check.
P3 U02/U03/U04 exits declare business NOT_APPLICABLE and have no separate dynamic evidence even though their approved units change business behavior.
The P3 exit does not bind target/capability/ancestor assertions and their red mutations to actual test methods.
The managed runner exits inside try on a remote Gradle failure, bypassing result collection and cleanup; a future failed first run would not meet log-first discipline.
